Motonia is built for motorcyclists: map-centric navigation, live rider visibility with privacy controls, real-time voice chat, group rides, hazard and police alerts, and ride-focused stats tied to your account.

Navigation & maps
Plan and ride with map-centric guidance suited to real roads and riding context, with interactive 3D maps and 3D bike models.

Flock Mode
Ride around the map and see the location of the ALPR cameras around your area

Group rides & voice chat
Host a group ride with a simple code and ride together with everyone's live position on the map. Talk to your crew with built-in group voice chat, or use proximity voice to hear riders near you — fading naturally with distance. Mute, block, and report controls are always available.

Live riders
See nearby riders when you choose to participate, with visibility settings: all riders, friends only, or hidden.

Proximity Chat
Talk to nearby riders as they get closer to you on the map, they fade away as they travel further away 

Police & hazard alerts
Community-sourced hazard and 3D police alerts appear on your map for everyone nearby. Reports are user-generated and may be inaccurate — always ride with your own judgment.

Leaderboards
Compete on top speed, miles ridden, and XP — globally or with friends.

Tracker
A live speedometer, lean-angle gauge, and wheelie timer for the track.

Safety
Hazard and map data can be incomplete or delayed. Never use Motonia while moving. Stop in a safe place before interacting with the app.

Profile
Profile and garage features — add friends, view profiles, and track your bikes.

Membership
Motonia is free to use, including group rides and voice chat. Premium unlocks turn-by-turn voice navigation, multiple motorcycles in your garage, and all future Premium features. With a range of features designed specifically for motorcyclists, Detecht is the ultimate app to help you stay safe, plan & navigate your routes, and connect with other riders.

The #1 app for people who love riding.

Safety Comes First

One of the most important features of Detecht is its safety tools. With automatic crash detection, safety tracking, and hazard warnings, you can ride with confidence, knowing that Detecht is always looking out for you. Our Automatic Crash Detection system will alert your emergency contacts in the event of an accident, while Safety Tracking keeps you connected to your loved ones with real-time location sharing. Our Hazard Warnings system will notify you of any potential hazards along your route, so you can stay alert and avoid accidents.

Plan Your Next Adventure

With Detecht's Route Planning features, you can create and navigate the perfect trip with just a few taps. Whether you're looking for curvy routes or round trips, Detecht has got you covered. Our planning tool makes it easy to customize your trip based on your preferences with stops, waypoints, and more. You can also explore over 250,000 user tracked routes to find the one that's right for you. The app allows you to plan your route in advance and ride it with our turn-by-turn GPS navigation and voice guidance, so you can focus on enjoying the ride when you're on the road. 

Connect with Other Riders

Detecht's motorbike community is a great way to connect with other riders. Our Social Feed lets you find riding buddies, share your experiences, and stay up to date on the latest news and trends. Take part in the discussions, chat with fellow riders, share routes, and plan your next adventure together.

Other Handy Features

In addition to the safety, route planning, and community features, Detecht also offers other handy tools for motorcyclists. The app supports GPX file formats, making it easy to import and export routes, while the ride statistics feature lets you track your progress and see how far you've come. These tools are perfect for serious riders who want to keep track of their progress and see how they're improving over time.

In summary, Detecht is the ultimate mobile app for motorcyclists, offering a range of features that cater to the needs of all riders. Whether you're a seasoned rider or just starting out, Detecht is the app you need to take your riding to the next level.
